name: Inky Tendrils
source: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
description: Six giant tentacles reach up from the ink lake, grabbing any foes in reach and dragging them underwater.
disable:
DC 48 Athletics (legendary) or DC 45 Acrobatics (master) to tie one tentacle into a knot, rendering it useless, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 44) to counteract one tentacle.

The death of the Daemonic Rumormonger permanently dispels all the inky tendrils.
routine: (6 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for every tentacle that is disabled or destroyed. The tentacles can combine their actions to use the hazard's Inky Imitator ability. A broken tentacle can still Strike, but it can't Grab. This hazard takes no multiple attack penalty.

generalAbilities.name: Black Ink Delirium
generalAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 Poison Damage damage and Confused (1 round)

generalAbilities.name: Inky Imitator
generalAbilities.description:
The inky tendrils cast a 10th-rank Duplicate Foe spell (DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw) on the target; on a failed save, a simulacrum of the target made from dripping ink and clockwork scraps emerges from any other spot (tendrils' choice) in the lake.

The tendrils don't need to Sustain the Spell; the duplicate exists for 1 minute or until it is destroyed before collapsing into a puddle of ink and scrap metal.

generalAbilities.name: Grab
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

generalAbilities.name: Constrict
generalAbilities.description:
(2d8+10) Bludgeoning Damage plus black ink delirium, Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

generalAbilities.name: Tendrils Come Alive
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-daemonic creature moves within 15 feet of the shoreline

Effect The hazard makes a tentacle Strike against the triggering creature and the hazard rolls initiative.
